definitions.explanation: The number eighteen. Formed by combining {十|じゅう} (ten) and {八|はち} (eight).

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{十八|じゅうはち}{歳|さい}で{大人|おとな}になります。
examples.english: In Japan, you become an adult at eighteen years old.

examples.japanese: {十八|じゅうはち}{番|ばん}を{選|えら}んでください。
{部屋|へや}は{十八|じゅうはち}{畳|じょう}あります。
examples.english: The room is eighteen tatami mats in size.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}の{誕生日|たんじょうび}は{十八|じゅうはち}{日|にち}です。
examples.english: My birthday is on the eighteenth.

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}が{来年|らいねん}{十八|じゅうはち}{歳|さい}になるので、もう{大人|おとな}ですね。
examples.english: My son will turn eighteen next year, so he'll be an adult.

notes:
{十八|じゅうはち} is eighteen, formed from {十|じゅう} (ten) + {八|はち} (eight).

LEGAL SIGNIFICANCE:
- Voting age: 18 (changed from 20 in 2016)
- Drinking/smoking age: remains 20
- {成人|せいじん} (legal adult): changed to 18 in 2022

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {十八歳|じゅうはっさい}: 18 years old
- {十八番|じゅうはちばん}/{十八番|おはこ}: one's specialty (idiom)
- {十八日|じゅうはちにち}: the 18th day of the month

SPECIAL READING:
{十八番|おはこ} means "one's specialty" or "favorite trick," derived from kabuki tradition.
